recommendation: Keep the fixed source commit as the FHIR-45047 reconciliation. Treat future computable disclosure of lastUpdated guarantees or separate extension/search-parameter work as FHIR-45012 or successor-issue scope rather than further changing this comment.
issue_request: FHIR-45047 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core BaseResource issue asking that Meta.lastUpdated guidance align with FHIR-I's understanding that the value is server-managed and may be out of sync with visible resource content. The final voted resolution changed the Meta.lastUpdated comments to describe server population and false-positive/false-negative update scenarios.
initial_application: FHIR-45012 first added related lastUpdated guidance in commit 8d7041c700. FHIR-45047 was later applied in commit 993291c03c by updating source/datatypes/meta.xml, but the application retained the phrase "it might be populated by the server when data is received or assigned when crafting the instance when constructing a response," which a Jira follow-up comment specifically flagged as two half sentences to fix while applying.
additional_context: Meta is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini and is marked normative, so source/datatypes/meta.xml is current build-scope source. FHIR-I minutes and the cited Zulip thread support the resolved semantics: lastUpdated is server-managed, servers should avoid missed updates, but the value may be out of sync with visible resource changes in either direction unless specified otherwise. FHIR-45012 remains a related FHIR-extensions/change-required issue and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed the Meta.lastUpdated comment to say that the server might populate the element when data is received or when crafting a response instance. The short and definition were left unchanged because the final voted disposition targeted the comments, and search.html was left unchanged because its _lastUpdated section points to Resource.meta.lastUpdated and is not misleading without duplicating the full element comment.
source_changes: source/datatypes/meta.xml: clarified the Meta.lastUpdated comments sentence describing when a server may populate the element.

related_jiras.note: Earlier lastUpdated/facade discussion added related guidance and was cited by FHIR-45047, but it remains a FHIR-extensions/change-required issue and was not independently decided.
